sources.facts: Brisbane City Council identifies the address as 501 Ann Street, heritage lot L51_SP214124, and the former brewery and RACQ aliases.

Construction-era report identifies Addison and MacDonald, three 12,000 square foot floors, buff brick walls with light trim, a curved main entrance with angular flanking towers, and broad horizontal windows. Consulted factual text only.
Architect records the standing 1942 building, retained heritage fabric and reuse as Callaghan Place. Consulted factual text only.
School records three occupied levels at 501 Ann Street and a distinct new link from its other buildings at level two.
State Library of Queensland identifies the newly built brewery headquarters in the July 1942 photo.
National Library of Australia duration guidance confirms pre-1955 photographs are out of copyright.
